sentence: This project builds a miniature factory on the skin that makes therapeutic cells directly inside the body.
This project studies how the nuclear lamina and chromatin communicate to cause gene repression.
This project tests whether MRI sialography guided sparing of parotid ducts reduces xerostomia in patients with oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma.
This project tests compounds that target enzymes in ornithine metabolism to see whether they work against cancers, alone and in combination.
This project tries to find out whether and how tobacco consumption affects individuals carrying a common genetic variant, using stem cells and mouse models.
This project studies how mitochondrial membranes are remodeled and how mitochondrial morphology responds to stressors such as oxygen deprivation.
This project builds computational methods that find patterns in DNA mutation data to reveal the biological mechanisms behind the alterations.
This project studies how a placenta-specific long non-coding RNA controls trophoblast differentiation and which molecules it interacts with.
This project builds models that predict complications in children after surgery using physiologic waveforms and electronic health record data.
This project studies how a protein regulates cell migration and polarity, using genetic, biophysical, biochemical and imaging techniques.
This project tests whether circuits linking the locus coeruleus and the cortex control behavioral engagement during alcohol-directed responding.
This project studies how tissues close millimeter-size gaps and develops tools to measure physical parameters in that process.
This project develops and validates flow and image cytometry-based assays that support cancer research programs.
This project studies how histone deacetylase 8 regulates cardiac myofilament relaxation by decreasing acetylation.
This project provides biostatistics and bioinformatics support for research projects on brain cancer.
This project tests whether a dietary supplement of omega-3 fatty acids safely reduces pain in adults with chronic temporomandibular disorder.
This project studies how immune cells and adipocytes communicate to turn on a heat generating gene program in white adipose tissue.
This project tests a technology that tries to increase the yield and quality of gene therapy manufacturing using synthetic helper genes.
This project studies how a methyltransferase drives colorectal cancer progression, using sequencing and genetic models.
This project studies how sleep helps consolidate fear memory in the basolateral amygdala, using calcium imaging and optogenetics.
